requiredEnv.name: WONTOPOS_API_KEY
requiredEnv.description: Wontopos API key (wos-live-...). Create one in the console at wontopos.com.

requiredEnv.name: WONTOPOS_USER_ID
requiredEnv.description: Default store for every tool call (default: "default").

requiredEnv.name: WONTOPOS_MODEL
requiredEnv.description: Engine to read with: tablet-2 (default — same token price as tablet-1, and the one that serves photos and re-ask), tablet-1, scroll-1, or scroll-1.2.

requiredEnv.name: WONTOPOS_VERIFY
requiredEnv.description: Default re-ask passes for search, 0-3 (default 0). Each pass is another engine call and is billed for what it delivers; the agent can raise it per call.

requiredEnv.name: WONTOPOS_MAX_IMAGES
requiredEnv.description: Default photo results per search, 0-5 (default 0). Zero because these rows ride on every search; the view_image tool fetches the one picture that is wanted.

requiredEnv.name: WONTOPOS_BASE_URL
requiredEnv.description: A different API host. Leave unset for the default.

requiredEnv.name: WONTOPOS_TIMEOUT_MS
requiredEnv.description: Per-request timeout in ms (default 20000). A stalled API then fails in-band instead of hanging the host.

requiredEnv.name: WONTOPOS_READ_ONLY
requiredEnv.description: Set to 1 for read-only mode: recall/search/list_memories/engram/stats/revisions only, no write or delete tools.

requiredEnv.name: WONTOPOS_ALLOW_STORE_OVERRIDE
requiredEnv.description: Set to 1 to let tools take a user_id argument (multi-store). Default: every call is pinned to WONTOPOS_USER_ID.

requiredEnv.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_PORT
requiredEnv.description: Serve over HTTP on this port instead of stdio, for hosts that cannot spawn a local process. Requires WONTOPOS_HTTP_TOKEN.

requiredEnv.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_TOKEN
requiredEnv.description: Bearer token every HTTP request must carry. Required whenever WONTOPOS_HTTP_PORT is set.

requiredEnv.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_HOST
requiredEnv.description: Interface to bind in HTTP mode. Default 127.0.0.1 (this machine only).

requiredEnv.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
requiredEnv.description: Comma-separated Host header values to accept in HTTP mode, for a tunnel that forwards its own public name. Loopback and the bind address are always accepted; anything else is refused 403.

servers.name: formio-mcp
servers.description: 从您的 AI 智能体创建和管理 Form.io 表单、资源、操作、角色和项目。

requiredEnv.name: FORMIO_PROJECT_URL
requiredEnv.description: Optional, and the WEAKEST of the three project sources: a committed formio.json found by walking up from the working directory wins, then the per-directory mapping project_set writes, then this. It pins nothing — project_set can redirect a directory whose environment names a different project. Useful for a launch with nowhere to record a project, such as CI or a container (e.g. https://examples.form.io on the hosted cloud; self-hosted it is either https://your-project.your-domain.com or https://your-host/project-name, depending on how that deployment routes projects). Leave it unset and the agent asks for a project and records it per directory.

requiredEnv.name: FORMIO_BASE_URL
requiredEnv.description: Optional, and usually unnecessary: the base URL is DERIVED from the project URL — https://api.form.io for a project on a form.io host, the parent path for a project addressed as a sub-directory — and is asked for only when it cannot be derived, which is a path-less project URL on a customer domain. There is no default. Like FORMIO_PROJECT_URL it is the weakest source, behind a committed formio.json and the per-directory mapping.

requiredEnv.name: FORMIO_API_KEY
requiredEnv.description: Form.io project API key. Optional — when omitted the server uses a browser-based portal login flow to obtain a JWT.

requiredEnv.name: FORMIO_LOGIN_FORM
requiredEnv.description: URL of a custom login form used by the browser-based portal login flow. Defaults to the deployment's portal login form.

requiredEnv.name: FORMIO_FORCE_BROWSER
requiredEnv.description: Set to 1 to attempt the browser login even where the server detects it cannot present one (CI, a container, a remote shell with no display). Use it when the login page is reachable from a browser elsewhere.

requiredEnv.name: FORMIO_INSECURE_TLS
requiredEnv.description: Set to 1 to skip TLS certificate verification. For local development against self-signed certificates only — never enable in production.
